price_out_of_band_scaling.decision: Replaced zero, negative, and out-of-band (<0.5x or >2.0x median) unit prices with the annual SKU median price across regions.
price_out_of_band_scaling.reason: Corrects cent-scale entry errors, currency conversion disparities, and manual data-entry slips while maintaining intra-year price stability.

blank_region_categorization.decision: Assigned persistent unmatchable blank regions to canonical category 'Unassigned'.
blank_region_categorization.reason: Preserves total company sales volume and transaction count without guessing geographic origins.

high_volume_orders.decision: Retained genuine large orders (>5000 units) in historical training data after validating non-corrupt status.
high_volume_orders.reason: Reflects genuine commercial customer bulk procurement rather than data transmission errors.

macro_2022_06_duplicate.decision: Row B (52.7) is closer to neighbour interpolation (52.85)
macro_2022_06_duplicate.reason: Preserves continuity with May 2022 and July 2022 macroeconomic indicators.

macro_2023_05_pmi_decimal.decision: Corrected 4.79 to 47.9 via decimal point shift.
macro_2023_05_pmi_decimal.reason: April 2023 was 47.2 and June 2023 was 46.1; value of 4.79 was a typographical single-decimal slip.

sku_bu_conflict_resolution.decision: Assigned PMP-004 to Business Unit 'Advanced Manufacturing' per Rule R8 and transaction history majority.
sku_bu_conflict_resolution.reason: All transaction records for PMP-004 consistently map to Advanced Manufacturing.
